In the name of God, Amen. I, Thomas Flynn, of the Borough of Shenandoah, County of Schuylkill, being of sound mind, make this my last will and testament. Witnesses: Owen Brennan, James Gallagher.

Petition of Patrick Flynn, executor, filed 20 November 1888: that the said Thomas Flynn died at Shenandoah on 11 November 1888.
